scope_rule: one package owns one directory under reconstruction/staging; this package creates and edits nothing outside reconstruction/staging/pkg-dogfood-00580cb0-a1 and reconstruction/metadata/pkg-dogfood-00580cb0-a1

reinspection.method: grep for the eight hex digits 00580cb0 over reconstruction/staging, reconstruction/metadata, reconstruction/integrated, reconstruction/knowledge and src, plus a per-address count over knowledgegraph/research/source-reconstruction-manifest.json and knowledgegraph/triage/xrefs-2540f2ca.tsv, plus read-only Ghidra queries against SporeApp.exe
reinspection.finding: The seven hits for 00580cb0 under reconstruction/ are reconstruction/evidence/00688fa0/evidence.json, reconstruction/evidence/00688fa0/evidence.md, reconstruction/evidence/006891f0/evidence.json, reconstruction/evidence/006891f0/evidence.md, reconstruction/knowledge/index.json and the two files this package owns. The first five are other workers' records that merely name this address as a call site of 0x00688fa0 or 0x006891f0. reconstruction/knowledge/index.json carries one record for 0x00580cb0 and that record is generated from the triage queue, not from a worker artifact. No staging package, no metadata sidecar, no integrated batch and no src file reconstructs the address, and knowledgegraph/research/source-reconstruction-manifest.json has zero occurrences of it.
reinspection.xref_shape: knowledgegraph/triage/xrefs-2540f2ca.tsv records twelve outgoing direct-call edges from 0x00580cb0 and no incoming direct-call edge. Its single incoming reference, from the triage snapshot, is the data word at 0x013f584c.
reinspection.conclusion: 0x00580cb0 is unclaimed. This package takes it without displacing another worker.
reinspection.ghidra_access: read-only: disassemble_function, read_memory, get_function_by_address. No rename, no comment, no type change, no save, no script run, no mutation of any kind.

owned.role: build a base file name, format a temporary and a final name from it, open the temporary, commit through a stack-built context object and a stack-built sink, then unconditionally run the handle's tail, promote the temporary over the final name, and return the handle's slot +0x04 dword
owned.abi: __thiscall, receiver in ECX, zero ordinary stack words, bare RET, dword result in EAX passed through from the final dispatch, ESI and EDI the only saved registers
owned.evidence: body 0x00580cb0..0x00580de2, 307 bytes, 91 instructions; 12 outgoing direct-call edges and zero incoming direct-call edges in the Ghidra export; one incoming data reference at 0x013f584c, which is offset 0x54 of the table at 0x013f57f8

adjacent_addresses_deliberately_not_mode.note: the stack probe the prologue calls at 0x00580cb5. All 19 instructions were read to fix what it does: it copies the caller's return address down to the bottom of the block it reserves and returns to that copy, which is why the store of 1 at 0x00580d56 lands on the word the probe left its return-address copy in. A compiler idiom, not a source-level call, so the model expresses the reservation as a large local and asserts only the return form.

the base-name filler, 54 instructions. Read for its contract only: cdecl, one stack word read at [ESP + 0x18], and L"EditorOfflineUser" at 0x013f5c44 on one of its two paths. Owned elsewhere; declared here as the port unresolved_00580c10.
the format wrapper, 11 instructions, forwarding four arguments plus a va_list marker to 0x00939950. Read for its contract only; declared as the port unresolved_00939a30.

the property write, 73 instructions. Read for its contract only: cdecl, four stack words, bare RET, and a fourth argument compared against 1 at 0x0093aa7a that selects between two call shapes. Declared as the port unresolved_0093aa70.

the constructor of the twelve byte frame object, 31 instructions, RET 0x10. It installs the table 0x01403970 at +0x00. Read for its contract and for the object's width; declared as the port unresolved_00693d60.
the base constructor 0x00693d60 tail-calls, 76 instructions, RET 0x10. Read to establish that +0x04 and +0x08 are polymorphic sub-objects rather than plain words. Owned elsewhere; not claimed.
the twelve instruction predicate on field +0x08, no frame, bare RET. Declared as the port unresolved_00692ea0.
the nine instruction sink setup, which forwards three stack words to 0x00692880 and returns its own receiver with MOV EAX,ECX / RET 0xc. Declared as the port unresolved_00692f90.

the 293 instruction sink commit, RET 0x4. It is what bounds the sink at 0xa10 bytes: it reads the receiver at +0xa00, +0xa04, +0xa08 and +0xa0c and walks 0x14 byte elements at +0x10 + index * 0x14. Declared as the port unresolved_00692900.
the 56 instruction destructor of the twelve byte frame object, bare RET, which re-installs the table 0x01403970 before releasing the two sub-objects. Declared as the port unresolved_00693900.

the temporary opener, 203 instructions, cdecl with one stack word. Already reconstructed by WAVE13-W1-DISPATCH-B02 as gge_user_data_reset_00688fa0, which is where this package's 0x24 byte width for the returned object comes from. That record also names 0x00580d08 as a call site but does not disassemble it; this package's own read of the call site is the evidence here. Declared as the port unresolved_00688fa0.

the promote, 239 instructions, cdecl with two stack words and ADD ESP,0x6c / RET, so the caller cleans up and this body does so at 0x00580dd3. Already reconstructed by WAVE13-W1-DISPATCH-B03 as wave13_w1_dispatch_b03_006891f0, whose record already lists 0x00580dc9 as a call site. Declared as the port unresolved_006891f0.

the table this body is an entry of. Read to place the body: 28 consecutive dwords from +0x00 to +0x70 followed by the narrow string "Casual" at +0x74, and a zero word at 0x013f57f4 immediately below, which is where an MSVC RTTI complete-object-locator pointer would be. Read as placement evidence; not claimed as a body.

the table both 0x00693d60 and 0x00693900 install into the twelve byte frame object at its +0x00. Its first word is 0x00693d40 and the narrow string "App/PropertyList/Variant/PointerPtr" follows it at 0x01403974. Read as a constant, not as a body; the class name in that string is not asserted to be the class this body belongs to.

not_claimed.item: the C++ class that owns the receiver
not_claimed.reason: The word immediately below the table at 0x013f57f8 is 0x00000000, so the RTTI complete-object-locator slot is empty and this binary carries no RTTI for the class. The body itself never dereferences its receiver, so nothing in the 91 instructions narrows it either. No class name is asserted.

not_claimed.item: the size, layout or role of the receiver
not_claimed.reason: MOV EDI,ECX at 0x00580cc1 is the only instruction that reads the incoming ECX and PUSH EDI at 0x00580d7c is the only place that copy is used. No word of the receiver is read or written, so nothing here bounds it. The model gives the type one opaque word and documents that as a placeholder rather than a size.

not_claimed.item: the declared type of the returned dword
not_claimed.reason: The machine forwards the final dispatch's EAX untouched, and there are no direct call sites to measure how the indirect callers consume it, so the model returns an opaque 32-bit word.

not_claimed.item: the meaning of the twenty-four bytes at 0x01897c18
not_claimed.reason: The body pushes that address three times and never dereferences it. The bytes there are a dword table whose entries rise in a constant stride of eight, which fixes an entry width and nothing else.
The body pushes that address once, as the second argument of 0x00692f90, and never dereferences it. The twenty-four bytes read at that address are zero.

not_claimed.item: the element width of the three path buffers
not_claimed.reason: The two formats are written with the count 0x100 and the three buffers are measured exactly 0x200 bytes apart, so each holds at most 0x100 elements of some width. Sixteen-bit units are consistent with the UTF-16 literals at 0x013f5c68 and 0x013f5c74 and with 0x00580c10's own 0x100, but this body does not prove the width independently, and the model says so.

not_claimed.item: whether the unguarded null dereference on the failure path is a defect or is unreachable in practice
not_claimed.reason: The bytes are unambiguous: the JZ at 0x00580d14 targets 0x00580da3, whose first instruction reads [ESI + 4]. Whether 0x00688fa0 can actually return null in a shipping session is a runtime question this repository has no instrument for. The model reproduces the dereference and the metadata records the question.

Read literally, 0x011e0700 leaves the stack pointer 0x1024 below entry while the epilogue releases two pops plus 0x1024, which is four bytes more. Only the local-address geometry decides between the two readings and it selects the one this package adopts, so the byte accounting is carried as an open question and the model asserts only the return form.

flag_rationale.-fno-stack-protector: this toolchain enables -fstack-protector-strong by default, which adds a gs:0x14 read and a second conditional branch to any body with an array local. The original has no canary, so turning it off brings the emitted body closer to the 91 original instructions rather than further away.
flag_rationale.-no-pie: a position-independent build folds the model's four data addresses into base-relative offsets with no absolute operand, which would make the count of referenced data addresses unmeasurable. -no-pie keeps that count meaningful and is how the original references them.

checks: clang-format --dry-run -Werror over the header, the source and the model test against the package local style file
all four configurations compile clean and the model test binary passes in all four
the emitted body makes exactly six register-indirect calls, one per table slot the body reads
the emitted body contains exactly one conditional branch
the emitted body returns with a bare ret, releasing zero stack bytes
every direct call in the emitted body targets one of the ten proven ports, apart from clang's own get-EIP self-thunk
all five observed slot displacements are present: +0x4, +0x8, +0x18, +0x1c, +0x20
the pushed immediates 0x100 and 0x1a80d26 are both present
the emitted body forms exactly four distinct data addresses, matching the four the body pushes
the emitted body hard-codes no image address, the one exception being the constant 0x1a80d26 whose value falls inside the image range
after the final dispatch the return value is only carried into EAX: no arithmetic on it, and no load of EAX through any register but the frame or stack pointer
negative_controls: NC1 adding a null guard to the tail makes the model test abort on the fault test, because the model would stop reproducing the original's unguarded dereference
NC2 adding one more port call inside the guard makes the model test abort on the dispatch sequence
NC3 swapping the two promote arguments makes the model test abort on the argument identities
NC4 moving the peer slot from +0x1c to +0x18 fails the compile-time static_assert on the table offset
NC5 moving the store of 1 to after the property write makes the model test abort, because the property write then reads a word that is not yet 1
NC6 replacing the returned dispatch dword with a constant makes the model test abort on the return value sweep
NC7 passing a stack slot other than the frame's sink to 0x00692900 fails the compile-time type check
NC8 changing the constructor's third address to a different global makes the model test abort, because the three pushed addresses are no longer identical
NC9 adding a seventh indirect dispatch makes the model test abort on the dispatch sequence

NC10 promoting the frame to a static passes every model test and is caught only by the boundary check, on the data-address count: the model test has no way to see a shared frame, so this is the one control that isolates the disassembly adjudication
NC11 adding a second conditional branch is caught by the boundary check on the branch count
